Leaptel questions

What is the cheapest Leaptel NBN plan?

Pronto NBN 25/10 at $50/mo for 6 months, then $75/mo. That is $750 over the first year (checked 5 October 2026).

Does Leaptel let you opt out of CGNAT?

Yes, Leaptel gives customers a public IP address free on request.

Do you need to give Leaptel 30 days notice to cancel?

No. Leaptel doesn't require a 30-day notice period to cancel.
